question: Should agents.defaults.pdfMaxBytesMb be allowed to raise inbound chat document extraction limits, or should this bug fix stay strictly tied to the existing mediaMaxMb attachment cap?
rationale: The stack-safe parsing fix is a clear bug repair, but the PR also broadens an existing config key's runtime meaning for inbound attachments; that compatibility and resource-policy choice should be intentional before merge.

options.title: Approve broadened config after rebase
options.body: Land the broadened pdfMaxBytesMb semantics only after the branch is rebased, ported to current UI files, and covered by fresh/upgrade tests for the new config contract.

options.title: Keep extraction tied to mediaMaxMb
options.body: Remove the pdfMaxBytesMb raise behavior and land only the parser, mediaMaxMb, pdfMaxPages, and stale queue cleanup fixes.

options.title: Split policy from parser repair
options.body: Merge a narrow parser and stale-queue fix first, then handle pdfMaxBytesMb inbound extraction in a separate product/config PR.

recommendation.title: Approve broadened config after rebase
recommendation.body: Land the broadened pdfMaxBytesMb semantics only after the branch is rebased, ported to current UI files, and covered by fresh/upgrade tests for the new config contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses gateway/media limits and config compatibility, and steipete has recent history on oversized-base64/media safeguards in this area.
